bundle.shortDescription: Always-on-top desktop widget for notes, tasks, and quick actions.
bundle.longDescription: Bilet-X is a minimalist always-on-top desktop widget for notes, tasks, and quick actions. Data stays local (SQLite in your app data directory) and a global hotkey brings it to any workspace.
